text: Tonight, Maya won't be able to call for help. Her phone will.
tts: [tense] Tonight, Maya won't be able to call for help... Her phone will.

text: This is Maya. Walking home after midnight.
One tap: Walk Home Guard is on. It listens on the phone only. Nothing is saved unless something's wrong.
Footsteps behind her.
Someone comes up behind her. She screams.
tts: [urgent] Someone comes up behind her. She screams.

text: Her phone hears it. A scream. The words: get off me.
Then she freezes. In one study of 298 survivors, 70% froze. She can't reach her phone. She doesn't have to.
tts: Then she freezes. In one study of two hundred ninety-eight survivors, seventy percent froze. She can't reach her phone. She doesn't have to.

text: Three phones ring. Each one gets her live location.
90 seconds, no safety PIN. A dispatcher calls. If she can't answer, police head to her live location.
tts: Ninety seconds, no safety PIN. A dispatcher calls. If she can't answer, police head to her live location.

text: Saturday. A party. Night Out Guard is on.
11:02. Someone spikes her drink.
11:20. The room starts to tilt.
tts: [uneasy] Eleven-twenty. The room starts to tilt.

text: No phone can detect a drug. But SafetySense notices what happens next.
11:31. She stumbles. Then she goes still. Her phone asks: You okay?
tts: Eleven thirty-one. She stumbles. Then she goes still. Her phone asks: You okay?

text: 45 seconds. No answer.
Her roommate's phone rings. She taps: I'm on my way.
What if someone takes her phone? Smashes it? Switches it off?
tts: [tense] What if someone takes her phone? Smashes it? Switches it off?

text: Her phone checks in with our server every minute. If it goes dark, the server raises the alarm itself.
A ride home. Ride Guard is on. The car turns the wrong way.
Her phone asks: You okay? The driver says: cancel it.
She types her duress PIN. The check-in disappears, like everything's fine. It isn't. Dispatch is already on it.
tts: She types her duress PIN. The check-in disappears, like everything's fine... [firmly] It isn't. Dispatch is already on it.

text: New Mexico still has no text-to-911. When you can't call, SafetySense calls for you.
tts: New Mexico still has no text to nine-one-one. When you can't call, SafetySense calls for you.

text: SafetySense. Calls for help when you can't.
It supplements 911. It never replaces it.
tts: It supplements nine-one-one. It never replaces it.

text: And if something happened to you, it's not your fault.
tts: [warmly] And if something happened to you... it's not your fault.
